gen-gf-tektur-general-sans: Pipe-cleaner strokes, oversized lowercase, generous openings: that's Tektur. It grabs attention up top, while General Sans quietly holds a steady pen pressure and an x-height that fills the line.
gen-press-start-2p-poppins: Poppins draws loose curves with no stroke flicker and a sturdy lowercase. Press Start 2P's retro spacing, letters pinned far apart like cut-outs, is the standout quality against that smooth ease.
gen-gf-autour-one-archivo: Autour One stitches its round letters like thread along a path, with no hairline shifts. Archivo, with its outward-opening curves and a commanding x-height, can sit a size or two smaller.
gen-gf-metamorphous-fs-epilogue: Distinctive from the first glance, Metamorphous sets its letters wide apart with a high midline and soft stroke contrast. Metamorphous earns its keep big and short; Epilogue handles everything else.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-fs-supreme: Tilt Neon draws tube-like letters of constant width with a splayed c. Supreme lays a heavy, crisp strip of open-looking text beneath, giving those wire-bent curves room to stand out.
gen-eater-fs-pilcrow-rounded: Wide gaps between every letter define Eater, whose stems are barely heavier than its thin strokes. Pilcrow Rounded does the opposite, crowding letters tight around big counters and constant-width arms.
gen-gf-goldman-fs-asap: Asap draws its c forms as open arcs, with a body height close to the capitals. Asap holds the text steadily while Goldman spreads wide, parenthesis-like round forms across the top.
gen-gf-grandstander-montserrat: Punchy, tall-bodied lettering: Grandstander draws bold, plain constant-width lines with short ascenders and a very tall x-height. Montserrat then glides underneath like wire, all white space and oversized counters.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-manrope: Love Ya Like A Sister lets its ascenders barely clear the x-height. Manrope adds bright open curves and a single-width pen line, so the outward-pointing terminals above meet something smooth.
gen-gf-paprika-switzer: Switzer keeps its c tips well apart and its tubular, wire-like letters free of pinching at every curve. Beside it, Paprika scatters capital-sized lowercase like a shout next to a murmur.
